summary: The full repository workflow is browser-proven on a clean app and three representative dogfood apps. The fresh fixture grew from one to two routes after sync. PRcard exercised a 17-route, four-flow curated workflow; Bleep exercised a 37-route scan-only project; Seatify exercised a 76-route named local environment. Every exact URL passed curl, rendered the complete toolbar/viewer, reported no browser warnings or errors, and was stopped afterward. README and the NavMap skill now lead with init, sync, and open while retaining low-level commands as advanced paths.
deviations: Dogfood project contracts lived in disposable roots with read-only symlink overlays so external repositories were not modified.
Browser proof intentionally used --no-screenshots; PRcard retained manifest evidence and the scan-only proofs verified route rendering without live app servers.
remaining_blockers: Only the final oracle-backed Judge/PM audit remains.
